column1: subservient§The board became subservient to a chief executive it had been created to supervise.§董事会变得**唯命是从**于一位它本被设立来监督的首席执行官。§sub（在下）+ serv（服务，同 servant 仆人）

subsidize§The state subsidizes the route by about four pounds a passenger, and the alternative is nine hundred stranded people.§政府对这条线路每位乘客**补贴**约四英镑，而替代方案是九百人无车可乘。§sub（在下）+ sid ← sed（坐，同 reside 居住）→ 在下面托着
subsist§Four families subsisted on that land for nine generations, and the survey lists it as unimproved.§四户人家靠那块地**维持生计**九代人，而勘测报告把它列为未开垦。§sub（在下）+ sist（站立，同 assist 协助）→ 勉强站住
subsistence§Subsistence farming supported the whole valley until 1974 and supports about four households in it today.§**自给性**农业养活了整条河谷直到 1974 年，如今只养活其中约四户人家。§
substance§There is no substance to the objection, and it has nonetheless delayed the project by nine months.§这条反对意见没有**实质内容**，却仍然把项目拖了九个月。§sub（在下）+ st（站立，同 stand 站）→ 底下站着的东西
substantial§A substantial share of the fund goes to administration, which the annual report puts at nine percent.§这笔基金**相当大的**一部分用于行政，年报给出的数字是百分之九。§
substantiate§Four of the nine claims could be substantiated, and the other five rested on a single anonymous letter.§九项指控中有四项能被**证实**，其余五项建立在一封匿名信上。§
substantiation§Substantiation took nine months, and the allegation had been public for four years by then.§**证实**花了九个月，而到那时这项指控已公开四年。§
substantive§The substantive change is in one clause; the other four pages are formatting and cross-references.§**实质性的**改动在一条条款里，其余四页是格式和交叉引用。§
subtle§The difference is subtle in the laboratory and, in a working kitchen, impossible to miss.§这个差别在实验室里很**微妙**，在真正的厨房里则不可能察觉不到。§sub（在下）+ til ← tel（织物）→ 织得细密
subtract§Subtract the four largest sites and the trend reverses, which the report never mentions.§**减去**最大的四个厂区，趋势就反转了，而报告从未提及。§sub（在下）+ tract（拉，同 attract 吸引）
subversive§The most subversive thing in the exhibition is a wall label quoting the institution's own 1974 policy.§这个展览里最**具颠覆性的**东西，是一张引用该机构 1974 年自身政策的展签。§sub（在下）+ vers（转，同 reverse 倒转）
subvert§Four small exemptions subverted a rule that had worked, without any exemptions, for nine years.§四项小小的豁免**颠覆**了一条无任何豁免、运行九年有效的规则。§
successor§Her successor reversed nine of her decisions and kept, without saying so, the four that mattered.§她的**继任者**推翻了她九个决定，又不动声色地保留了要紧的四个。§suc（在后）+ cess（走，同 recede 后退）
succinct§The succinct summary on page one is the only part of the report that four ministers actually read.§第一页那段**简洁的**摘要，是四位部长真正读过的唯一部分。§suc（在下）+ cinct（束，同 precinct 辖区）→ 束紧
succulent§The succulent stores nine months of water in its leaves and flowers only after heavy rain.§这种**多汁的**植物在叶片里储存九个月的水，只在大雨后开花。§suc（汁）
succumb§The bridge succumbed on the fourth day, and nine engineers had certified it as sound.§这座桥在第四天**垮掉**，而九位工程师曾认定它结构完好。§suc（在下）+ cumb（躺，同 incumbent 在职的）→ 倒下去
sufficient§Four hours' notice is not sufficient for a decision that will bind the council for nine years.§对一个将约束议会九年的决定来说，四小时的通知**不够**。§suf（在下）+ fic（做，同 factory 工厂）
suffrage§Suffrage was extended in 1918 to about eight million women and withheld from four million more.§**选举权**在 1918 年扩及约八百万名女性，另有四百万人仍被排除在外。§
suggestive§The evidence is suggestive rather than conclusive, and four newspapers reported it the other way round.§证据是**提示性的**而非决定性的，而四家报纸的报道恰好相反。§
sundry§Sundry small charges added nine percent to a bill the customer had been quoted as fixed.§**各式各样的**小额收费给一张顾客被告知是固定价的账单加了百分之九。§
supercede§The 1994 guidance supercedes four earlier documents, three of which are still in circulation.§1994 年的指引**取代**了四份更早的文件，其中三份仍在流传。§super（在上）+ ced（走，同 recede 后退）→ 坐到上面去
supercilious§His supercilious reply to a junior colleague was the only part of the meeting anyone remembered.§他对一位年轻同事**目空一切的**回复，是这场会议唯一被人记住的部分。§super（在上）+ cili（眼睑）→ 挑起眉毛看人
superficial§The review was superficial: four hours for a system that took nine years to build.§这次评审是**浮于表面的**——对一个建了九年的系统只用四小时。§super（在上）+ fic（面，同 surface 表面）
superficiality§The superficiality of the coverage is the story: nine outlets, one source, and no questions.§报道的**肤浅**本身就是新闻——九家媒体、一个来源、零提问。§
superfluous§Nine of the eleven forms are superfluous, and removing them would save about four thousand hours a year.§十一张表里有九张是**多余的**，去掉它们每年约省四千小时。§super（在上）+ flu（流，同 fluid 流体）→ 溢出来的
superiority§Her sense of superiority was invisible to her and obvious to the four people she supervised.§她的**优越**感她自己看不见，对她管的四个人则显而易见。§
superstitious§The crew was superstitious about the fourth voyage and, that year, had every reason to be.§船员对第四次航行**迷信**忌讳，而那一年他们确实有充分理由。§super（在上）+ st（站立）→ 立在理性之上的说法
supplant§Cheap imports supplanted a local industry in about four years and left nine hundred people unemployed.§廉价进口品在约四年内**取代**了本地产业，让九百人失业。§sup（在下）+ plant（脚掌，同 plantar 足底的）→ 从下面绊倒对手
supple§The leather stays supple for about nine years if it is oiled, and four months if it is not.§这种皮革上油能保持**柔韧**约九年，不上油则只有四个月。§sup（在下）+ pl ← plic（折叠，同 complicate 使复杂）→ 好弯折
supplement§The supplement adds nine pages of tables and answers none of the four questions readers actually asked.§这份**增补**加了九页表格，读者真正问的四个问题一个也没回答。§sup（在下）+ ple（填满，同 complete 完整的）
supplementary§The supplementary payment is worth four hundred pounds and requires a form nine pages long.§这笔**补充**款项值四百英镑，要填一张九页长的表。§
supplication§The supplication ran to nine paragraphs and received, four months later, a two-line refusal.§这份**恳求**书写了九段，四个月后收到两行的拒绝。§sup（在下）+ plic（折叠／弯曲）→ 屈膝相求
supportive§The most supportive colleague she had was the one who told her, four times, that she was wrong.§她最**支持**她的同事，正是那个四次告诉她她错了的人。§
suppress§The finding was suppressed for nine years and published, when it finally appeared, without comment.§这项发现被**压制**了九年，最终发表时未加任何说明。§sup（在下）+ press（压）
suppressive§The suppressive measures worked for four years and produced, in the fifth, exactly what they were meant to prevent.§这些**压制性**措施奏效了四年，第五年恰恰产生了它们要防止的东西。§
surfeit§A surfeit of guidance has replaced the four rules that people actually used to follow.§指导的**过剩**取代了人们从前真正遵守的那四条规则。§sur（超过）+ feit ← fac（做，同 factory 工厂）→ 做过头
surly§The surly porter turned out to know more about the building than the four archivists did.§这位**态度粗暴的**门房，原来比四位档案员更了解这栋楼。§sir（老爷）→ 摆老爷架子
surmise§One can only surmise why the file was closed, since the four people who decided have all died.§只能**推测**这份卷宗为何结案，因为做决定的四个人都已去世。§sur（在上）+ mis（送，同 mission 使命）→ 从上面丢下个猜想
surreptitious§The surreptitious recording ran for nine minutes and settled a dispute that had lasted four years.§这段**偷偷进行的**录音有九分钟，了结了一场持续四年的争议。§sur（在下）+ rept（爬取，同 rapt 抓取）→ 偷偷摸到手
surrogate§The committee used attendance as a surrogate for engagement, and the two turned out to be unrelated.§委员会用出勤作为参与度的**替代指标**，结果两者毫无关系。§sur（代替）+ rog（询问，同 interrogate 审问）
susceptible§Four of the nine varieties are susceptible to the fungus, and those four are the ones people plant.§九个品种中有四个**易感染**这种真菌，而人们种的正是那四个。§sus（在下）+ cept（拿，同 capture 捕获）→ 底下接得住
suspend§The service was suspended for nine days, and four hundred people found out from a notice on a door.§服务**暂停**了九天，四百人是从门上一张通知得知的。§sus（在下）+ pend（悬挂，同 pendulum 摆）
suspicion§Suspicion fell on the one person with an alibi, which took four months to check and confirm.§**怀疑**落在了唯一有不在场证明的人身上，核实确认花了四个月。§
suspicious§The most suspicious thing in the file is what is not there: nine months of missing correspondence.§卷宗里最**可疑的**东西是不在其中的——九个月不见踪影的往来信件。§
sustain§The grant sustained the project for four years, and the ninth year is the one everyone remembers.§这笔资助**维持**了项目四年，而人人记得的是第九年。§sus（在下）+ tain（拿住，同 contain 容纳）→ 从下面托住
sustenance§Sustenance for nine hundred people came from four wells, and two of them failed that August.§九百人的**生计所需**来自四口井，其中两口在那年八月干涸。§
sycophant§The sycophant lasted four years and left the moment the director he flattered retired.§这个**马屁精**待了四年，在他奉承的主任退休那一刻走了。§sykon（无花果）+ phainein（显示）→ 告密者
syllogism§The syllogism is valid and the conclusion is false, which means one of the premises must be wrong.§这个**三段论**形式有效而结论为假，这意味着必有一个前提是错的。§syn（一起）+ log（说，同 logic 逻辑）
symbiotic§The relationship is symbiotic: the fungus feeds the tree and the tree feeds four hundred fungi.§这种关系是**共生的**——真菌喂养树木，树木喂养四百种真菌。§syn（一起）+ bio（生命，同 biology 生物学）
symbolize§The four columns symbolize nothing at all; the architect simply needed to hold up the roof.§这四根柱子不**象征**任何东西——建筑师只是需要撑住屋顶。§syn（一起）+ bol（投掷，同 ballistic 弹道的）
symmetry§The symmetry of the façade is nine centimetres out, and nobody noticed for four hundred years.§这个立面的**对称**差了九厘米，四百年无人察觉。§syn（一起）+ metr（测量，同 meter 米）
sympathetic§The most sympathetic hearing she got was from the person with the least power to help.§她得到的最**有同情心的**倾听，来自最无力帮她的那个人。§syn（一起）+ path（感情，同 pathos 悲怆）
symptomatic§The delay is symptomatic rather than exceptional: nine of the last eleven projects ran over.§这次延误是**典型症状**而非例外——最近十一个项目里有九个超期。§
syncopate§Musicians syncopate the fourth beat of every bar, and the whole character of the piece changes at once.§乐手把每小节的第四拍做**切分**处理，整首曲子的性格立刻就变了。§syn（一起）+ cop ← copt（切）
synergistic§The effect is synergistic: either drug alone does little, and together they do about nine times more.§这种效应是**协同的**——任一种药单用作用不大，合用则约多出九倍。§syn（一起）+ erg（工作，同 energy 能量）
synthesize§She synthesized nine hundred pages of evidence into four conclusions the committee could act on.§她把九百页证据**综合**成四条委员会可以据以行动的结论。§syn（一起）+ thes（放置，同 thesis 论点）
tacit§The tacit rule was never written down and was broken, for the first time, in the fourth year.§这条**心照不宣的**规矩从未写下，第四年头一次被打破。§tac（沉默，同 taciturn 沉默寡言的）
taciturn§The taciturn engineer said nine words in the meeting, and four of them changed the design.§这位**寡言的**工程师在会上说了九个词，其中四个改变了设计。§
tact§Tact would have cost him nothing, and the sentence he chose cost him four years of goodwill.§**得体圆通**本不会让他损失什么，而他选的那句话让他损失了四年的善意。§tact（触碰，同 contact 接触）→ 分寸感
tactful§Her tactful correction saved a colleague from repeating a mistake in front of four hundred people.§她**委婉得体的**纠正，让一位同事免于在四百人面前重复一个错误。§
tactile§The exhibition is deliberately tactile, and about nine visitors in ten touch something they should not.§这个展览刻意做成**可触摸的**，约十位访客中有九位摸了不该摸的东西。§tact（触碰，同 contact 接触）
tangential§The four tangential questions took ninety minutes, and the central one was never put to a vote.§四个**离题的**问题占了九十分钟，而核心问题始终没有付诸表决。§tang（触碰，同 tangible 可触知的）→ 只擦着边
taunt§The taunt was answered nine years later with a paper that settled the question for good.§这句**讥讽**在九年后得到回应——一篇彻底解决了那个问题的论文。§
tawdry§The tawdry plastic replacement cost the church four times what properly restoring the original would have.§这件**俗艳廉价的**塑料替代品，让教堂花的钱是妥善修复原件的四倍。§ 源自 St Audrey 集市上的劣质饰带
